text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhhhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!!
As expected, this year's Derby Umamusume is none other than myself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It couldn't have been anyone other than King Halo!
Ohohoho! Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: You were incredible, just as expected!
You were incredible, just as expected!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, naturally!
Because I am a first-class Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Over here for
a look and a pose, please!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now, everyone will know my name...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. I simply thought a winner
deserves a backdrop truly fitting for one.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Right, not on a turf track like this—a glamorous live stage makes a much more fitting backdrop for me, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Change of plans, everyone!
The photo shoot here is over!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I'll give you the privilege
of capturing my shining stage presence on that camera of yours!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!?
No way, please hold on~?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... Not giving a single thought to my schedule.
Just what you'd expect from a selfish, spoiled rich girl...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And acting like winning was a given.
This is the Derby, you know?
It'd be a lot cuter if she acted a bit more innocent, or—

...Faint whispers from the reporters reached my ears.
However—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Now, I must make my name known to everyone...

...Suddenly, I glance in the direction
she seemed preoccupied with for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuuugh... *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Mom... I couldn't become the best in Japan...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hey... where did that young lady go?
Is she really not doing any interviews until the concert?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... And it was such a photogenic spot, too~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're late, Trainer.
You're a hundred million years too early to keep the King waiting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Don't just give me an 'I'm sorry.'
Honestly... you're way too intoxicated by King's victory."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"As a first-rate Trainer
worthy of a truly first-rate Umamusume—"
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That must be Mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Seeing this victory,
have you finally decided to acknowledge me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, no helping it.
Let's answer the phone♪"
(Beep)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Mother?
Fufu, did you by any chance watch today's Derby—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Yes, I was watching. It was incredible—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Special Week-san. It has been a long time
since I last saw a performance that captivated people so deeply."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yet the one who won was me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Indeed. Since you got lucky with a win, you'd better turn back before the veneer wears off."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘Seriously, what was that behavior at the press conference earlier?
Just up and vanishing on the reporters like that...’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: T-That's...

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Abandoning the responsibilities of a winner...
How childish. You've gotten far too carried away."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...If things stay as they are, I fear for the future."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "At this rate, you won't survive in this world."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I suggest you come home
before you embarrass yourself any further."
(*Click*... *beep beep*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. Let us be sure to achieve results in the upcoming 'Kikuka Sho.'"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...As if I'd let it end with things remaining misunderstood like this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "won't survive"? What's so "pathetic" about it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As the star of this Classic season,
I can keep shining bright!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not to Seiun Sky-san, nor to Special Week-san,
I won't lose to whoever is out there.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I am King Halo!!
I am a talented Umamusume, and—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume who deserves recognition!
Ohohoho...!

However, that hearty laughter
felt much weaker than usual...
